points: Shamgar the son of Anath slew six hundred Philistines with an ox goad — a spiked stick for driving cattle — and it does not say he had a troop with him. The spirit of the Lord was on him. God raised Ehud up, God raised Gideon up, and God is raising men up today.

note.label: The Mind of Mattathias: Let's Search the Scriptures

points: After Ehud was Shamgar the son of Anath, which slew of the Philistines six hundred men with an ox goad; and he also delivered Israel.
